title: Liouville theorems for stable solutions to the mean curvature equation
summary: We study stable solutions of the mean curvature equation $$ -\operatorname{div}\left(\frac{\nabla u}{\sqrt{1+|\nabla u|^2}}\right) =|u|^{p-1}u $$ in domains of $\mathbb R^n$. We establish Liouville-type results in three settings. First, for globally stable solutions in $\mathbb R^n$, we prove that $u\equiv0$ if $1 2$ and $p=p_S$, where $p_S$ is the Sobolev critical exponent, then $u\equiv0$.
